'''Agent''' was a rank to denote an [[operative]] with an organization. The term "agent" could also be used to describe any individual in service to a government or organization.

==Usage==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], several agents with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] assisted the Republic in tracking down the missing plans to the [[Planet Prison]] and its designer, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]].<ref name="SWTORRescue">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Rescue|Coruscant}}</ref>

Agent was also a rank in the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. Above agents were [[Special Agent/Legends|Special Agents]].

The [[Republic Treasury/Legends|Republic Treasury]] used the rank for members of the [[Republic Treasury Audit Division]].

During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] utilized the rank of Agent for its members. Agent [[Mar Barezz]] led the efforts to capture the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] operative [[Tay Vanis]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Breakout" />

Other notable holders of the rank included [[Cladus Glynn]], [[Breezer Nos-Carron]], [[Dagnian Sark]], and [[Elena Shelvay]].

The rank of agent was also held within the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Trask Lucan]] was one of the New Republic agents.<ref name="PoC">''[[The Politics of Contraband]]''</ref>
